# Rula

> Rula is an online mental health platform connecting patients with licensed therapists and psychiatrists who accept insurance for treatment of ADHD, anxiety, depression, and other conditions.

Rula offers virtual therapy and psychiatry services with a network of in-network providers across major U.S. cities. The platform specializes in insurance-covered mental health treatment with transparent pricing and personalized provider matching based on specialties and location.

## Key Topics

- Online Therapy
- Psychiatry Services
- Insurance Coverage
- Licensed Therapists
- Provider Matching
- Medication Management
- LCSW (Licensed Clinical Social Worker)
- LMFT (Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist)
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- EMDR
- Anxiety & Depression Treatment
- Telehealth
- In-Network Providers
- Therapy Cost Estimator
- Mental Health Counseling

## Core Services

- [Connect with mental health experts who specialize in you](https://www.rula.com): Rula homepage: online therapy platform for ADHD, anxiety, depression with insurance coverage
- [Online Psychiatry Services - Rula](https://www.rula.com/psychiatry): Rula's online psychiatry services with medication management from licensed providers
